clips.title: The story
paras: The Horde is a coalition of outcast nations united under Warchief Thrall to secure their mutual survival and freedom. Anchored by the shamanic bond of the orcs, Darkspear trolls, and tauren across Kalimdor, the faction also maintains an uneasy alliance of convenience with the Forsaken in Lordaeron. Beset by historical grievances and hostile neighbors, the Horde values strength, action, and honor over political maneuverings.

The modern Horde bears little resemblance to the demonic army that marched through the Dark Portal in the First and Second Wars. After shattering the Burning Legion's grasp upon his people, Warchief Thrall led the orcs across the Great Sea to Kalimdor to build a spiritual homeland founded on ancestral traditions and honor. Along the way, Thrall forged lasting ties with Vol'jin's displaced Darkspear trolls and Cairne Bloodhoof's tauren tribes, fighting side by side to drive off centaur and demonic incursions during the Third War.
